dedupe_keys.name: city of brussels annual energy consumption of the municipal building stock

description: Ville de Bruxelles, Data Management publishes the annual energy consumption of the City of Brussels' real estate holdings, based on billing, as normalised gas, electricity and water use; buildings the City rents and does not pay the bills for are excluded. Coverage: the municipal building stock of the City of Brussels, Belgium, as 18 yearly rows; updated annually, record last modified on 2026-09-11. Format and access: CSV, JSON, downloadable without registration from the Brussels open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC0 1.0; cost: free. Caveats: only yearly totals for the whole municipal stock, not per building; the portfolio changes from year to year, which the provider says affects comparisons. Simulation uses: trends in public-building energy demand for decarbonisation and energy-supply scenarios. Related catalogue records: Energies - Consommation énergétique des bâtiments occupés par l’administration parisienne (data-energies-consommation-energetique-des-batiments-occupes-par-ladministration-parisienne).
